The couple are the SAME as @Image1: a woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark-brown hair in a plain cream knit sweater and blue jeans, and a man in his early 50s with short salt-and-pepper grey hair in a plain light-blue polo and blue jeans. Photoreal, small controlled pressing-together motion, plain clothing with no text or logos. No on-screen text, no captions, no logos.

sections.note: 22.04s. Seedance inferred eight visual shots and seven cuts without boundary timestamps: first side lift → connector macro → opposite side → perpendicular wall → wall press → large narrow board → small narrow board → stand-up. This is promising but is one sample; watch for cabinet topology drift and temporary extra-looking panels at cuts.

sections.label: Experiment summary
sections.note: Preliminary recommendation: author one continuous Blender motion, try a combined Seedance auto-edit first, and regenerate only failed segments as controlled per-shot calls. The combined run got the intended eight-stage edit structure in this single trial, while isolated generation remains better for precise retries. Estimated spend for all eight calls: $24.21 (preflight estimate, not invoice).
